nihil_raider.desc: Hit and run: after it shoots, it dashes back toward cover.

nihil_storm.desc: Nihil officer. One gas grenade: anyone it catches chokes (−15 aim for 2 turns).

path_runner.desc: Rides a secret hyperspace Path. Not here on turn 1; drops in behind your squad on turn 2.

drengir.desc: Carnivorous plant. Hurts everyone. A vine hit roots the target: it cannot move next turn.

nameless.desc: Force horror: only hurts Jedi; troops are immune. Dread: Jedi within 3 tiles aim −15 and lose 1 Focus each enemy turn.

great_progenitor.desc: Drengir hive mother. Armor 1, roots what it hits, and a new Drengir sprouts beside it every 3 turns. Defeat it to win.

lourna_dee.desc: Tempest Runner of the Nihil. Armor 1. The first time she drops to half HP she Path-jumps across the field and heals 3. Defeat her to win.

lourna_ret.desc: She got away from you once. She came back for the Eye's big night.

marchion_ro.desc: The Eye of the Nihil. Armor 2. Whoever he shoots is Marked: every Nihil gets +15 aim against them until his next turn. Defeat him to win.

leveler.desc: Ro's Nameless. Only hurts Jedi; troops are immune and must carry this fight. Dread aura (3 tiles): Jedi aim −15, lose 1 Focus a turn.

root_mother.desc: A Drengir bloom anchored in the soil. Does not move or attack; a Drengir sprouts beside it every 3 turns. Destroy it to win.

h_hetzal.brief: A starship broke apart in hyperspace. Its pieces are still falling on Hetzal at lightspeed. Masked raiders are already looting the wreck fields. Walk a survivor to the evac at the north end.
h_hetzal.goal: Walk the survivor to an evac zone (E). Raiders shoot and dash back to cover. A Path-Runner drops in behind you on turn 2. Threat rises after turn 6.
h_hetzal.win: The survivor is out. Marshal Avar Kriss asks who your squad is.
h_hetzal.lose: The impact fields swallow the last transport.
h_hetzal.quote: “We are all the Republic.” — Chancellor Lina Soh

h_grove.near: The grove is about to swallow the valley. Next turn you must pull out.
h_grove.escape: The grove closes over the valley.
h_grove.brief: The Drengir are waking: plants that think, hunt, and eat. Their hive mother, the Great Progenitor, has rooted in a valley of farms. Cut her out before the grove spreads.
h_grove.goal: Defeat the Great Progenitor (16 HP, armor 1). A Drengir sprouts beside her every 3 turns, and vine hits root you in place. Threat rises after turn 7.
h_grove.win: The Progenitor withers. The grove goes quiet, then brown.
h_grove.lose: The grove swallows the valley. The farmers do not come back.
h_grove.quote: “It is a garden. It is hungry.” — Master Stellan Gios [N]

h_valo.brief: The Republic Fair: a whole world dressed up to show the frontier what the Republic can be. The Nihil came to burn it. Hold the Chancellor's pavilion for 7 turns while the crowds get out.
h_valo.goal: Hold the pavilion for 7 turns. Path-Runners drop in behind your line; Storms throw choking gas.
h_valo.win: The pavilion stands. Lina Soh walks out of the smoke and thanks every one of you by name.
h_valo.lose: The pavilion burns on every holonet in the galaxy.
h_valo.quote: “Light and life. Today we show them both.” — Chancellor Lina Soh [N]

h_tempest.push: Lourna's crew spins up the Path engines.
h_tempest.near: Her ship is almost ready to jump. Next turn she is gone.
h_tempest.brief: Intel from Valo points to a Nihil hideout at the edge of Wild Space and one of the three Tempest Runners: Lourna Dee. Take her down before her ship jumps.
h_tempest.goal: Defeat Lourna Dee (13 HP, armor 1). At half HP she Path-jumps away once and heals. Threat rises after turn 6; at Threat 6 she escapes.
h_tempest.win: Lourna Dee goes down hard. The Nihil lose a Tempest.
h_tempest.lose: Her ship jumps. She will remember your faces.
h_tempest.quote: “A Tempest Runner does not run.” — overheard, Nihil channel [N]

h_husks.brief: Three Jedi went into this outpost. Their comlinks still answer. They are standing in the corridors, gray as stone, and they crumble when touched. Copy the outpost logs and find out what did this.
h_husks.goal: Scan 2 of 3 terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then reach an evac zone. All 3 tells you more. The Nameless only hurts Jedi: send troops first.
h_husks.win: The logs name it: a Nameless. Ro keeps one on a leash.
h_husks.lose: The outpost goes dark with you still in it.
h_husks.quote: “Something out there eats the Force. Find out what.” — Grand Master Pra-Tre Veter [N]

h_beacon.push: Another section of the station goes dark.
h_beacon.near: Starlight is losing orbit. Next turn it falls.
h_beacon.brief: The Nihil are inside Starlight Beacon. The station is failing, and something on board is turning Jedi to dust. Marchion Ro is here to watch it fall. Stop him while Starlight can still be saved.
h_beacon.goal: Defeat Marchion Ro (14 HP, armor 2) before Threat 6, when Starlight falls. The Leveler only hurts Jedi: troops are immune. Ro Marks whoever he shoots.
h_beacon.win: Ro falls on his own station. Starlight holds its orbit.
h_beacon.quote: “For light and life.” — Jedi of the High Republic (C, High)

h_roots.near: The roots are about to reach the town.
h_roots.brief: A Drengir bloom has rooted in farmland. It grows a new Drengir every few turns. Nihil scavengers are picking through what is left. Destroy the Root-Mother.
h_roots.goal: Destroy the Root-Mother (14 HP, armor 1). A Drengir sprouts beside it every 3 turns. Threat rises after turn 7.
h_roots.win: The bloom dies. The town keeps its fields.

h_salvage.brief: Republic crews are pulling a fallen hull out of a field before it can kill anyone else. The Nihil want what is inside. Hold the crane for 6 turns.
h_salvage.goal: Hold the salvage crane for 6 turns. Path-Runners drop in behind you.
h_salvage.win: The hull comes up empty of Nihil.

h_scouts.brief: A Republic pathfinder mapped a Nihil Path and lived. The Nihil know it. Get him to the shuttle.
h_scouts.goal: Walk the VIP to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 6: more hunters arrive and they shoot the VIP on sight.
h_scouts.win: The pathfinder's charts reach the Republic.
h_scouts.lose: The charts burn with the camp.

h_cache.brief: The Nihil hide their Path engines here, the secret that lets them strike anywhere. Plant charges on 2 sites, then get every standing squad member onto the evac zone.
h_cache.goal: Plant 2 charges (adjacent, 1 action), then get everyone still standing onto the north evac zone. Threat rises after turn 7: techs defuse an armed charge each step.
h_cache.win: The cache goes up. The Nihil jump less often for a while.

h_prisoners.brief: The Nihil hold a prisoner on a barge. A Medic can Hack the cell door from 4 tiles; a Jedi can try the console. Then walk the prisoner to an evac zone (E).
h_prisoners.goal: Open the cell (Hack or console), then get the prisoner to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 5; at Threat 6 they fly the prisoner out.

h_buoy.brief: A relay is passing Nihil orders between Storms. Copy its terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then get anyone to an evac zone.
h_buoy.goal: Scan 2 of 3 terminals, then reach an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 6: terminals get wiped. Shoot alarm beacons before they call help.
h_buoy.win: The Storms' orders are ours for a month.

h_outpost.brief: A Republic outpost is the only beacon for twenty systems of settlers. Nihil raiders want it dark. Hold it for 8 turns.
h_outpost.goal: Hold the outpost for 8 turns. Path-Runners drop in behind you.

h_roots.text: A Drengir bloom is growing new Drengir in a farm valley.

h_salvage.text: Nihil raiders are hitting a Republic crew pulling a fallen hull out of a field.

h_scouts.text: A pathfinder who mapped a Nihil Path is pinned in his camp.

h_cache.text: Blow the cache that lets the Nihil jump anywhere.

h_prisoners.text: A Padawan is held on a Nihil prison barge.

h_buoy.text: A relay is passing Nihil orders. Copy them and get out.

h_outpost.text: Raiders are closing on the only beacon for twenty systems.

EVENTS.text: Chancellor Lina Soh wants Jedi on Starlight Beacon, her great work on the frontier. Master Veter worries the Order is becoming the Republic's lantern.

choices.label: Veter's way: a few, as guests

EVENTS.text: Republic pathfinders want Jedi escorts to map new hyperlanes after the Disaster. Glory, risk, and Senate goodwill.
Orla Jareni, a Wayseeker who answers to no Council, offers her white blade to your strike teams. "For a while. Until the Force says otherwise."
Mother Grappa, a Hutt, offers a crop poison that kills Drengir. Her price: Jedi look away from her spice ships for a year.
Master Yoda, already centuries old, comes to the Temple between journeys. He offers a season of teaching.
A Nihil taken at Valo names their leader: Marchion Ro, the Eye. The Senate wants proof before it acts.

choices.label: Veter's way: give the Senate proof

EVENTS.text: A Wayseeker felt something empty on the frontier. Like the Force had a hole in it. The Council does not want to hear it.
A Nihil Storm's accounts show payments in coin no bank has ever issued. Someone outside the Nihil is feeding them. [N]
Bane died in a Jedi cell centuries ago. His holocron is still in the Temple vault, and a Padawan says it has started to whisper. [N]

trooper.lore: Sith Empire infantry, trained hard and ordered harder. Most of them believe in the Empire because they have never been offered another future.

heavy.lore: A walking wall in Imperial plate, with a gun that wants to be heard. It is slow to turn and quick to punish those who stand still.

agent.lore: Imperial Intelligence does not announce itself. A cold hide, a long rifle, and a patience the Temple’s own scouts would respect.

acolyte.lore: A student of the Sith, hungry to be noticed by someone with more power. Lightning crackles in the fingers, and mercy has not yet been taught.

husk.lore: What is left when a great horror feeds. A Dark Husk has no mind of its own, only hunger, and it moves when its maker kills.

terentatek.lore: A beast bred, it is said, to hunt those who touch the Force. The Jedi who survive an encounter rarely describe it, but the nightmares do.

envoy.lore: A Republic envoy with the right smile and the wrong friends. Whispers say that someone close to the talks is selling the schedule.

malgus.lore: A Sith Lord who believes the Republic is a lie and means to prove it with fire. He fights like a man with nothing left to lose.

mando.lore: Mandalorian clans, hired by the Empire for the oldest reason there is. They fight with honor and are paid in credits.

adraas.lore: Lord Adraas fought beside Malgus in the strike on Coruscant. Those who faced him remember how little he seemed to care about the cost.

bh_trooper.lore: Foot soldiers of the Brotherhood of Darkness, devoted to Lord Kaan’s vision. They fight as though the war were already won, and that certainty is their weapon.

bh_marauder.lore: A Dark Side warrior who fights for rage as much as for Kaan. The wounds only seem to feed it.

sith_lord.lore: One of the Brotherhood’s Lords, who sees the Light as a delay to be removed. The troopers around it fight as if its approval were air.

bh_sniper.lore: A hired gun on the ridge who is paid to be patient. The Brotherhood buys loyalty with ideals and loyalty from this one with credits.

sith_spawn.lore: A creature born of the dark side in the Ruusan caves, hungry only for the Force. Soldiers without the gift pass it unnoticed, and it cannot forgive that.

nexus.lore: A wound in the world where the dark side pools and festers. It does not move or speak, but it makes more of itself.

nexus_core.lore: The heart of the cave, where the dark gathers. It beats slowly, and anyone who stays near it begins to hear it.

kaan.lore: Lord Kaan, leader of the Brotherhood of Darkness, sure that the Sith should lead the galaxy. He is brilliant, ruthless, and wrong in a way he will never accept.

bane.lore: Darth Bane, a Sith apprentice who watches from the ridge and listens to the war with a stranger’s attention. He survives Ruusan, and what he builds from it will outlast everyone here.

vorr.lore: Kaan's field commander, a soldier first and a Sith second. He holds high ground the way other men hold grudges. [N]

nihil_raider.lore: Masked marauders who strike from hyperspace and are gone before help arrives. They share loot by Tempest, Storm and Cloud. (C, High)

nihil_storm.lore: A Storm commands a band of Nihil Clouds. Their gas masks are half armor, half warning. (C, High; gas grenade [N])

path_runner.lore: The Nihil fly secret hyperspace Paths no one else can compute. That is how they appear behind you. (Paths: C, High)

drengir.lore: Sentient carnivorous plants, one hive mind, very old and very hungry. They call their prey "meat". (C, High)

nameless.lore: Creatures that feed on the Force. Near one, a Jedi feels terror and loses the Force; what is left turns gray and crumbles. Troops feel nothing. (C, High)

great_progenitor.lore: The oldest Drengir, root of the hive. Every Drengir hears her. (C, High)

lourna_dee.lore: A Twi'lek Tempest Runner of the Nihil, ruthless even by Nihil standards. (C, High; her fight here [N])

lourna_ret.lore: Lourna Dee, back for the Eye. She never forgets a face. [N]

marchion_ro.lore: The Eye of the Nihil, an Evereni who hides his true aim behind a helmet. He wants the Jedi broken, not dead. (C, High)

leveler.lore: The Nameless that Marchion Ro keeps on a leash. Jedi called it the Leveler. (C, High)

root_mother.lore: A Drengir bloom left to grow becomes a nursery. [N]

coruscant.lore: The capital of the Republic, a world of endless towers and the Jedi Temple above the noise. For centuries it has felt untouchable.

alderaan.lore: A world of mountains and old noble houses. In this age it hosts the peace talks that the galaxy has been waiting for.

balmorra.lore: A world of foundries and weapon yards, fought over by both sides. Little of it has been left unscarred.

ordMantell.lore: A rough Mid Rim world of depots, smugglers, and Republic outposts. Easy to reach, hard to hold.

dantooine.lore: Open plains and quiet ruins, once home to a Jedi enclave. Rumor says the grassland hides things that hunt by night.

narShaddaa.lore: The Smuggler’s Moon, a glittering stack of neon and debt. Anything can be bought here, at a price someone else usually pays.

ossus.lore: A world of ruined Jedi archives, scoured by old wars. The shelves are empty in places, and the silence is not entirely empty.

ilum.lore: The ice world where Jedi come to find their kyber. The caves hum with something older than the Order.

taris.lore: A city world that has been burned and rebuilt more than once. The old towers still stand above the ruins of what they were.

tython.lore: The birthplace of the Jedi Order, far from the noise of the core. After the treaty, the Order turns toward it again.

korriban.lore: The tomb world of the ancient Sith. Dust and stone, and a presence that waits.

dromundKaas.lore: A jungle world of storms and predators, the seat of the Sith Empire. Its capital rises out of the rain like a threat.

hydianWay.lore: A hyperspace road that carries trade and troops alike. Whoever holds it holds the pulse of the Outer Rim.

ruusan.lore: A world scarred by a war that burned a thousand years later in memory. Its forests remember the cost of certainty.

hetzal.lore: A frontier system struck by the Great Hyperspace Disaster in 232 BBY. (C, High)

valo.lore: Host of the Republic Fair, a frontier world dressed up to show the galaxy the Republic. (C, High)

starlight.lore: Starlight Beacon: a station built to light the frontier for ships and the Jedi. (C, High)

wildspace.lore: The dark between charted lanes. The Nihil call it home. (C, Med)

zym.lore: Grand Master of the Order, tired and unyielding. He carries a Council’s worth of doubt, and does not let it show.

gnost.lore: A Kel Dor Jedi historian, breath-masked and unhurried. He believes that the past is the only teacher that cannot be bribed.

darach.lore: A Zabrak Jedi Master with a patient smile and a hard-earned scar. He teaches best by letting others make their own mistakes.

satele.lore: A young Knight with a famous name and an unfinished story. She carries the weight of a lineage she did not choose.

jace.lore: A Republic soldier who has seen too much and complained about it too little. His platoon would follow him anywhere sensible.

malgus.lore: A Sith Lord of terrible resolve, who struck at the heart of the Republic and meant it. His pain is not hidden, and neither is his power.

adraas.lore: A Sith Lord who commanded beside Malgus. He is cold, capable, and he regards the Temple as a trophy waiting to be taken.

eleena.lore: A Twi’lek who stands at Malgus’s side by choice. She sees more of him than anyone else does, and she is not afraid.

kira.lore: A Guardian Knight who leads from the front. She says little about the people she has lost, and carries every name.

tor.lore: A Consular Padawan with a mind quicker than his nerve. He is learning that courage is just fear that keeps walking.

dax.lore: A sergeant with twenty years of mud on his boots. He does not believe in luck, and keeps his squad alive anyway.

ilsa.lore: A scout who moves like a rumor. She prefers to be forgotten, and rarely is.

bren.lore: A medic with tired hands and a steady voice. He has lost patients, and has never stopped trying for the next one.

grak.lore: A heavy trooper built like a doorframe. Gentle in the barracks, immovable on the line.

saresh.lore: A Republic envoy with an easy manner and a careful vocabulary. Whatever he says, there seems to be something else behind it.

ondo.lore: A Senator with a loyal voice and a long list of enemies. He wants the treaty badly, and the Temple wants him alive to sign it.

corin.lore: An Imperial officer who changed sides at some personal cost. He is trusted a little less than he deserves, and a little more than he expects.

mira.lore: An aide who knows where every document is and who has read most of them. Quiet, observant, and indispensable.

thulHeir.lore: Lady Venna Thul, heir to an old Alderaanian house. She is young, careful, and aware that her name weighs more than she does.

hoth.lore: Lord Hoth leads the Army of Light. A blunt soldier who never wanted to be one. In canon he dies in the thought bomb. (Legends, High)

farfalla.lore: Valenthyne Farfalla, a Lord of the Army of Light. Flamboyant, merciful, and the one who leads the Jedi after Ruusan. (Legends, High)

johun.lore: Johun Othone, Hoth's student. In canon he survives Ruusan and builds its memorial. (Legends, High)

kaan.lore: Lord Kaan built the Brotherhood of Darkness by making every Sith a Lord. Equality, he called it. It made the Sith easy to count. (Legends, High)

bane.lore: Darth Bane. In canon he walks away from Ruusan, the only Sith left, and writes the Rule of Two. (Legends, High)

tarn_vel.lore: A Brotherhood apprentice who walked into a Jedi camp with his hands open. Nobody is sure yet whether he meant it. [N]

vell.lore: Lord Tarsus Vell, an Army of Light Lord taken in the sixth battle. Loud, brave, and very glad to be alive. [N]

veter.lore: Pra-Tre Veter, a Grand Master of the Order in this age. Patient, careful, thinking of the Order's nerve more than its glory. (C, Med)

gios.lore: Stellan Gios, a Jedi Master who joins the High Council around 231 BBY. The face of the Order on the frontier. (C, High; seat date Med)

kriss.lore: Avar Kriss, Jedi Master, hero of Hetzal and Marshal of Starlight Beacon. She hears the Force as a song. (C, High)

soh.lore: Lina Soh, Chancellor of the Republic. Starlight Beacon and the Republic Fair are her Great Works. (C, High)

orla.lore: Orla Jareni, a Wayseeker: a Jedi who walks her own path outside the Council. Her saber is white and double-bladed. (C, High)

yoda.lore: Yoda, born ~896 BBY, is already a Master of centuries here. (C, High on his age; his role in this era Med)

grappa.lore: Mother Grappa, a Hutt who did business with Drengir and Jedi alike. (C, Med)

ro.lore: Marchion Ro. In canon he survives Starlight and goes on to wall off part of the frontier. (C, High)

lourna.lore: Lourna Dee, Tempest Runner. In canon she spends time in Republic custody under a false name. (C, Med)

relay.lore: A lonely relay on the frontier, keeping the lanes open for ships that never learn its name. The Sith want it silent, and they are coming in waves.

shrine.lore: Pilgrims have long come to a kyber shrine on Dantooine. Tonight something else has found it, and it has an appetite for the Force.

rescue.lore: A supply depot on Ord Mantell holds prisoners who matter to someone. The plan is simple, which means it will not go simply.

envoy.lore: Schedules leaked, secrets traded, and a trail that winds through the lower city. Someone near the talks is selling the Republic.

archive.lore: An Imperial listening post on Balmorra, tucked between foundries. What it hears could hurt the Republic, and what it holds could help.

sabotage.lore: An Imperial fuel depot on Balmorra, vast and poorly lit. A well-placed charge here could stall an advance for weeks.

escort.lore: A Senator must walk the length of Coruscant’s lower streets to reach the talks. The Temple walks with him.

blockade.lore: Mandalorians in Imperial pay have closed a stretch of the Hydian Way. A convoy is counting on the squad to open it.

cache.lore: A listening post on the Inner Rim has gone quiet. The squad is sent to find out why before anyone else does.

hutt.lore: A Hutt warehouse on Nar Shaddaa holds a ledger of debts and deals. In the right hands it could change the war.

dock.lore: Docking Ring Nine. Malgus is coming for the Temple, and the Jedi have one chance to stop him at the door.

vault.lore: Beneath the ruins of Ossus lie old records of the Sith wars. Gnost-Dural wants them saved, and the Empire wants them first.

ilum.lore: A cave mouth on Ilum, cold and humming. Sergeant Malcom’s platoon holds it, and the Jedi arrive in time to share the watch.

adraasHunt.lore: During the talks on Alderaan, Satele Shan leads a strike on Lord Adraas at an embassy hangar. It is a gamble with the treaty as the stake.

taris.lore: A reclamation camp on Taris, where captives were put to work. The Jedi come to open the gates, and to see who is still inside.

thul.lore: The heir to House Thul must cross Alderaan unseen. The Jedi go with her, because some journeys are not safe alone.

depot.lore: Forward Depot Cresh keeps the enemy fed and armed. Take away the depot and the front shifts.

fort.lore: Fort Garnik on Ord Mantell is old, battered, and still standing. The Republic means to keep it that way.

r_ravine.lore: The wounded of the Army of Light lie in a ravine as the Brotherhood closes in. Among them is Johun Othone, a young Knight in Lord Hoth’s service.

r_caves.lore: The caves of Ruusan run deep, and the Brotherhood is gathering in them. Some of what moves in the dark has no interest in soldiers at all.

r_bomb.lore: Kaan’s ritual would end the Light and the Dark together. Hoth goes to stop it, and the squad goes ahead of him.

r_hospital.lore: The Army of Light cares for its wounded far behind the line, and that is exactly where the Brotherhood strikes. The healers must be given time.

r_nexus.lore: Deep in the caves, the dark side has found a place to grow. It breeds only what hunts the gifted, so the troops go first.

r_snipers.lore: A courier carries the Army’s plans along a ridge trail, and the Brotherhood has paid for rifles to watch it. The road is short and the cover is thin.

r_dump.lore: The Brotherhood marches on powder and fuel. Take away the dump and the army slows, and that may be the difference.

r_muster.lore: The Army of Light came to Ruusan in transports, lit down by a single beacon. [N]

r_sixth.lore: The sixth battle of Ruusan went to the Brotherhood. Its prisoners went to Kaan. (battle count: Legends, High; details [N])

r_seventh.lore: The seventh and last battle of Ruusan. Kaan's army broke and fled into the caves. (Legends, High)

r_prisoners.lore: The Brotherhood took prisoners to break them, and sometimes to turn them. [N]

r_codes.lore: Kaan gave his orders by courier and by signal. The signals were faster, and easier to steal. [N]

r_supply.lore: Hoth's army ate what the convoys brought. When the convoys stopped, so did the army. [N]

h_hetzal.lore: 232 BBY: the Legacy Run broke apart in hyperspace and its pieces emerged at lightspeed across the Hetzal system. (C, High)

h_grove.lore: The Drengir woke on the frontier soon after the Disaster. The Jedi fought them world by world. (C, High; this grove [N])

h_valo.lore: The Republic Fair on Valo, a showcase of Lina Soh's Republic, was attacked by the Nihil. (C, High; ~231 BBY, Med)

h_tempest.lore: The Nihil were led by three Tempest Runners under the Eye. (C, High; this raid [N])

h_husks.lore: Jedi taken by the Nameless were left as gray husks that crumbled to dust. (C, High; this outpost [N])

h_beacon.lore: Starlight Beacon, the Republic's great station on the frontier, was sabotaged by the Nihil and fell ~230 BBY. (C, Med on date)

h_roots.lore: A Drengir bloom left alone grows more Drengir. [N]

h_salvage.lore: For months after the Disaster, wreckage kept emerging from hyperspace. Salvage was a war of its own. (C, Med)

h_scouts.lore: Republic pathfinders mapped new hyperlanes after the Disaster, and the Nihil hunted them. (C, Med)

h_cache.lore: Path engines let the Nihil compute jumps no one else could. (C, High; this cache [N])

h_prisoners.lore: The Nihil held Jedi prisoners to trade, break, or feed to something worse. [N]

h_buoy.lore: Nihil orders moved Tempest to Storm to Cloud. [N]

h_outpost.lore: Frontier outposts were the Republic's promise made of durasteel. [N]

FLAG_LINES.e3_hetzal_saved: You pulled survivors out of the Hetzal impact fields.
FLAG_LINES.e3_grove_done: You went into the Progenitor's grove.
FLAG_LINES.e3_progenitor_down: The Great Progenitor died in her grove.
FLAG_LINES.e3_valo_held: The Chancellor's pavilion held at Valo.
FLAG_LINES.e3_ro_named: A captured Nihil named the Eye: Marchion Ro.
FLAG_LINES.e3_lourna_dead: Lourna Dee will never run another Tempest.
FLAG_LINES.e3_lourna_escaped: Lourna Dee jumped away. She will be back.
FLAG_LINES.e3_leveler_found: You read the outpost logs: you knew what the Leveler was.
FLAG_LINES.e3_beacon_saved: Starlight Beacon did not fall. In canon it fell into the sea of Eiram.
FLAG_LINES.e3_beacon_fell: Starlight Beacon fell, as it did in canon.
FLAG_LINES.e3_ro_down: Marchion Ro died on Starlight. In canon he lived to burn more of the frontier.
FLAG_LINES.orla_joined: Orla Jareni walked with your strike teams.
FLAG_LINES.e3_sith_hint: You followed strange coin from the Nihil to someone else. The trail went cold.
FLAG_LINES.e3_beacon_warned: You gave the Senate proof about Ro before Starlight.

h_hetzal.win: The survivor holds Avar Kriss's hand the whole way up.
h_hetzal.lose: Hetzal counts its dead in the millions.

h_grove.win: Farmers come back to the valley. They burn everything green, just to be sure.
h_grove.lose: The valley is a grove now. Nothing in it is a farm.

h_valo.win: The Fair goes on, the next day, smaller and braver.
h_valo.lose: Valo will be remembered for the smoke.

h_tempest.win: Her crew surrenders one by one. None of them will say where the Eye is.
h_tempest.lose: The hideout is empty by the time the Republic arrives.

h_husks.win: The Council reads the logs and orders them sealed.
h_husks.lose: Three more Jedi gray and crumble in the dark.

h_beacon.win: The beacon still burns over the frontier. Some nights it is the only light.

path_runner.lore: The Nihil fly secret hyperspace Paths no one else can compute. That is how they appear behind you. (Paths: C, High)

drengir.lore: Sentient carnivorous plants, one hive mind, very old and very hungry. They call their prey "meat". (C, High)

nameless.lore: Creatures that feed on the Force. Near one, a Jedi feels terror and loses the Force; what is left turns gray and crumbles. Troops feel nothing. (C, High)

great_progenitor.lore: The oldest Drengir, root of the hive. Every Drengir hears her. (C, High)

lourna_dee.lore: A Twi'lek Tempest Runner of the Nihil, ruthless even by Nihil standards. (C, High; her fight here [N])

leveler.lore: The Nameless that Marchion Ro keeps on a leash. Jedi called it the Leveler. (C, High)

root_mother.lore: A Drengir bloom left to grow becomes a nursery. [N]

kriss.lore: Avar Kriss, Jedi Master, hero of Hetzal and Marshal of Starlight Beacon. She hears the Force as a song. (C, High)

soh.lore: Lina Soh, Chancellor of the Republic. Starlight Beacon and the Republic Fair are her Great Works. (C, High)

orla.lore: Orla Jareni, a Wayseeker: a Jedi who walks her own path outside the Council. Her saber is white and double-bladed. (C, High)
